thesis: A local-first, model-agnostic control plane for persistent embodied AI under explicit control.
release_status: Not yet qualified for V1; all four public proof gates remain open.

components.name: ModelRig
components.role: Control plane, policy, persistent state and client integration

components.name: Consciousness Core
components.role: SelfState, WorldState, time, attention and continuity

components.name: ThoughtEngine
components.role: Replaceable cognition without authority over persistent identity

components.name: VisionRig
components.status: Physical camera and Kinect acceptance remains open

components.name: BodyRig
components.role: Body, geometry, movement and identity likeness

components.name: Kaliv VR
components.role: Unity and OpenXR embodiment on Quest
components.status: Quest, latency and soak testing remain open

v1_proofs.name: Controlled Core activation
v1_proofs.pass_condition: Continuity survives restart and model switching without state divergence.

v1_proofs.name: Physical perception
v1_proofs.pass_condition: Physical sensor events reach WorldState with accepted, traceable provenance.

v1_proofs.name: One persistent person
v1_proofs.pass_condition: Identity, voice, body and behavior remain coherent across Windows, Android and Quest.

v1_proofs.name: Operational proof
v1_proofs.pass_condition: Latency, soak testing and exact-head checks pass the recorded release manifest.
